run_load_voxel_map: run the CLI script to load a sparse voxel map from a pickle file and display it
create_sparse_voxel_map: create a SparseVoxelMap instance with a configurable voxel resolution for 3D spatial mapping
read_voxel_map_from_pickle: read a sparse voxel map from a pickle file using the read_from_pickle method
show_voxel_map_instances: show the sparse voxel map visualization with instance labels enabled
get_2d_map_from_voxel: get a 2D map representation from a sparse voxel map for debugging or navigation
